drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our initial draft for discussion, subject to client approval. The settlement amount and payment deadline remain open. We have clarified that the release becomes effective only upon receipt of full payment and added customary confidentiality exceptions. Please provide your client's proposed payment terms and confirm the specific claims and proceeding to be covered by the release.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds no later than [PAYMENT DEADLINE TO BE AGREED], using payment instructions separately provided by Plaintiff and independently verified by Defendant.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from the claims specifically identified in [DESCRIPTION OF CLAIMS AND PROCEEDING TO BE AGREED]. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall give the other party prompt advance notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek confidential treatment.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve only the claims expressly identified in Section 2.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) in a single lump sum by wire transfer of immediately available funds no later than seven calendar days after the date on which the last party signs this Agreement, using payment instructions separately provided by Plaintiff and independently verified by Defendant.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from the following expressly identified claims: [PRECISE CLAIMS TO BE CONFIRMED], asserted in [CASE CAPTION TO BE CONFIRMED], before [COURT TO BE CONFIRMED], Case No. [CASE NUMBER TO BE CONFIRMED]. The release is limited exclusively to those expressly identified claims and excludes all unrelated claims and all claims not expressly identified above. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.
